concept.movement: A deliberate four-beat column-legged walk with long balanced steps, little bounce and a quiet heavy torso. Faster travel keeps staggered support and becomes a purposeful brisk walk; ears, trunk and tail follow with restrained secondary motion.
concept.attack: The elephant braces its broad feet, loads back, curls the trunk clear of the tusks and drives the head and shoulders forward into a forceful tusk-led shove. It lands heavily and recovers its broad stance.
concept.death: The trunk briefly curls clear as the forelegs yield and the knees fold. The broad body settles heavily onto a supported flank; ears fold at their bases, the trunk relaxes in a coherent curve and the tail settles beside the rump.
